exhaust: Long walks exhaust my little dog.
走很远的路会把我家小狗累坏。
Does the long game exhaust the little kids?
玩太久游戏会让小朋友们精疲力尽吗？
Don't exhaust the old horse with too much work.
别让老马干太多活，会把它累垮的。
exhausted: My father was exhausted when he got home.
爸爸到家的时候已经累坏了。
Why does the old dog look so exhausted?
这只老狗看起来怎么这么累呀？
Wow, that exhausted old horse slept all day!
哇，那匹累坏的老马睡了一整天！
exhaustion: Exhaustion made the little dog stop and sleep.
小狗累得不行，停下来睡着了。
Do you feel exhaustion when you run too long?
跑太久的时候，你会觉得筋疲力尽吗？
Nap and drink water when you feel exhaustion.
觉得累透了，就睡一觉、喝点水。
exhibit: My panda painting is in the art exhibit.
我的熊猫画在美术展览里展出呢。
Did you see the dinosaur exhibit at the library?
你看到图书馆的恐龙展览了吗？
Come to the new robot exhibit with me!
跟我一起去看新的机器人展览吧！
exile: The story tells of a little mouse in exile.
这个故事讲的是一只流亡在外的小老鼠。
Why must the fox live in exile?
狐狸为什么只好背井离乡生活呢？
Oh no, the little bear is in exile!
exiled: The fox was exiled to the far forest.
狐狸被流放到了遥远的森林。
Who was exiled in the old story?
Oh no! The bear was exiled from the jungle!
哎呀！大熊被赶出了丛林！
exoskeleton: A crab has a hard exoskeleton on its back.
螃蟹背上有一层硬硬的外骨骼。
Does a beetle have an exoskeleton too?
Look! Every little insect has a hard exoskeleton!
看！每只小昆虫都有硬硬的外骨骼！
exotic: The forest has an exotic bird with big wings.
森林里有一只长着大翅膀的珍奇鸟。
What exotic animals live in the hot jungle?
炎热的丛林里住着哪些珍奇动物呢？
Wow! What an exotic butterfly that is!
expand: Air makes the little balloon expand.
Will the bread expand when it gets warm?
Watch the little seed expand in the water!
看小种子在水里慢慢泡大吧！
expansion: The park's expansion gave us more room to play.
公园扩建后，我们玩的地方更大了。
When will the expansion of the street be over?
街道的扩建什么时候完工呀？
Look at the big expansion of the city!
快看，这座城市扩大了好多！
expatiate: He can expatiate about dinosaurs for a long time.
他能滔滔不绝地讲好久好久的恐龙。
Why does he expatiate about his little dog?
他为什么老是喋喋不休地夸他家小狗呀？
Please don't expatiate about your long dream!
请不要没完没了地讲你的长梦啦！
expectant: The dog gave me an expectant look.
小狗满眼期待地看着我。
Why does your cat look so expectant?
你的猫为什么一脸期待的样子？
Look how expectant the bunny is!
expedition: The expedition into the jungle will start at seven.
What did you find on your forest expedition?
你们森林探险时发现了什么？
Take your backpack on our expedition to the pond!
去池塘探险要背上你的背包哦！
expense: The new bike was a big expense.
那辆新自行车花了一大笔钱。
Is a new computer a big expense?
买一台新电脑是一大开销吗？
What a big expense the new roof was!
expensive: That car is too expensive for us.
那辆车对我们来说太贵了。
Why is the train ticket so expensive?
火车票为什么这么贵呀？
Don't buy the most expensive toy in the store.
别买店里最贵的那个玩具。
experience: Swimming in the ocean was a fun experience.
在大海里游泳是一次有趣的经历。
Was camping in the tent a good experience?
在帐篷里露营的感觉好吗？
Come to summer camp for a new experience!
来参加夏令营，体验新事物吧！
explanation: The worker gave us an explanation of the robot.
工人叔叔给我们讲解了那个机器人。
Can you give me an explanation of this word?
你能给我讲讲这个单词是什么意思吗？
Listen to the explanation and then try again.
先听讲解，然后再试一次。
exploit: The little mouse's exploits are fun to read.
小老鼠的英勇事迹读起来特别有趣。
Did you hear about the fox's exploits?
你听说过那只狐狸的冒险事迹吗？
Tell us about your exploits at the lake, Grandfather!
爷爷，给我们讲讲你在湖边的历险吧！
exploration: The exploration of the jungle was long and hard.
那次丛林探险又漫长又艰苦。
Do you like books about ocean exploration?
你喜欢看海洋探索的书吗？
Start your forest exploration at the big tree.
从那棵大树开始你的森林探险吧！
explosion: The popcorn made a little explosion in the pan.
爆米花在锅里噼里啪啦地炸开了。
Did the popcorn make a big explosion?
爆米花爆出很大的响声了吗？
Wow! What a big popcorn explosion!
explosive: The hot pan makes an explosive noise.
热锅会发出噼啪的爆响。
Was that explosive noise from the stove?
那阵爆响是炉子发出来的吗？
Step back when the popcorn pan gets explosive.
爆米花锅噼啪响的时候要退后一点。
exponent: In this number, the small two is the exponent.
在这个数里，小小的二就是指数。
Is the little two the exponent here?
这里的指数是小小的二吗？
Put the exponent up high by the big number.
把指数写在大数字的右上方。
export: The farmer exports apples to cities far from here.
这位农民伯伯把苹果出口到很远的城市。
Does the farmer export fruit to other cities?
这位农民伯伯往其他城市出口水果吗？
Our farmers export so much fruit!
我们的农民伯伯出口好多水果呀！
expose: Don't expose the milk to the hot sun.
别把牛奶放在大太阳底下晒。
Why did you expose the bugs under the rock?
你为什么把石头下的小虫露出来呀？
Opening the box will expose the new toys.
打开盒子就能看到新玩具了。
exposure: Too much sun exposure is bad for you.
在太阳底下晒太久对身体不好。
Does the plant need more exposure to the light?
这株植物需要多晒晒光吗？
Use an umbrella to stop too much sun exposure.
打把伞，免得在太阳下晒太久。
expression: Her smile is a warm expression.
她的微笑是最温暖的神情。
What expression do you use when you say hello?
打招呼的时候你会用哪种说法？
Sing the song with big expression!
唱这首歌要带足感情哦！
exquisite: The cupcake has exquisite little flowers on it.
纸杯蛋糕上装饰着精美的小花。
Did you see the exquisite dress in the store?
你看到店里那条精致的裙子了吗？
What exquisite work this painting is!
extension: The house extension has two big windows.
房子新扩建的部分有两扇大窗户。
When will the extension be over?
Look at the new extension on the old house!
快看老房子新扩建的部分！
exterminate: Chickens help exterminate the bugs in the garden.
小鸡帮忙消灭花园里的害虫。
How do you exterminate the flies in the house?
你们是怎么消灭屋里的苍蝇的？
Ask father to exterminate the snails on the plants.
请爸爸消灭植物上的蜗牛吧。
extinction: We read a book about dinosaur extinction.
我们读了一本关于恐龙灭绝的书。
What can people do to stop animal extinction?
人们能做些什么来阻止动物灭绝呢？
Let's help the animals and stop extinction!
我们一起保护动物，不让它们灭绝吧！
extinguish: Water can extinguish a small fire.
Did the workers extinguish the fire in the forest?
工人们扑灭森林大火了吗？
Extinguish the camp fire with water and dirt.
用水和泥土把营火浇灭。
extract: We extract seeds from a big pumpkin.
我们从大南瓜里取出种子。
Can you extract the toy from the box?
你能把玩具从盒子里取出来吗？
Extract the seed and put it in the dirt.
把种子取出来，埋进土里。
extraordinary: My grandmother makes extraordinary cupcakes with little flowers.
我奶奶做的纸杯蛋糕漂亮极了，上面还有小花。
Did you see the extraordinary fish in the pond?
你看到池塘里那条奇特的鱼了吗？
What an extraordinary thing to see at the beach!
在海滩上看到的东西真神奇呀！
extraterrestrial: My book is about a little extraterrestrial.
我的书讲的是一个小外星人的故事。
Do you think extraterrestrial animals live on the moon?
你觉得月亮上住着外星动物吗？
Wow! The little extraterrestrial wants to go home!
exult: 夏天来的时候，我们欢呼雀跃。
Do you exult when you get a gift?
收到礼物时你会欢呼吗？
Exult and jump for your team!
为你们的队伍欢呼跳跃吧！
exultation: She jumped in exultation when she got the gift.
她拿到礼物时高兴得跳了起来。
Can you hear the exultation of the kids?
你能听到孩子们的欢呼声吗？
What exultation when the team got the cup!
球队捧起奖杯时，大家多么欢腾呀！
eyewitness: An eyewitness saw the fox in our garden.
一位目击者看见狐狸出现在我们的花园里。
Was the eyewitness at the game yesterday?
那位目击者昨天在比赛现场吗？
Be an eyewitness and tell us what you saw.
你来当目击者，说说你看到了什么。
fabled: The book has a fabled horse that can fly.
书里有一匹传说中的会飞的马。
Have you read the fabled story about the fish?
你读过那个关于神鱼的传说故事吗？
Tell us a fabled story at night!
晚上给我们讲个传说故事吧！
fabric: Mother got blue fabric to make me a dress.
妈妈买了蓝布料，要给我做条裙子。
Is this warm fabric for my new coat?
这块暖和的布料是做我新外套的吗？
Look at all the colorful fabric in the store!
看店里五颜六色的布料呀！
fabricate: Robots fabricate the small toys in that big building.
那栋大楼里的机器人负责制造小玩具。
Why did you fabricate that story about the dog?
你为什么编了一个关于小狗的故事呀？
Never fabricate stories about your friends.
千万别编造关于朋友的假话。
fabulous: We had a fabulous time at the beach!
我们在海滩玩得超级开心！
What a fabulous drawing of a horse!
这幅马的画画得太棒了！
facet: Helping is one facet of a good friend.
爱帮忙是好朋友的其中一面。
What facet of school do you like most?
学校生活里你最喜欢哪一面？
Find one more facet of your good friend!
再找找你好朋友身上的另一面吧！
facetious: Don't be facetious when your father is here.
爸爸在场的时候别乱开玩笑。
Are you being facetious again, little brother?
弟弟，你又在说俏皮话逗人吗？
His facetious words made us all laugh.
他滑稽打趣的话把我们都逗笑了。
factor: Sun and water are a big factor for plants.
阳光和水分是植物生长的重要因素。
Is hard work a big factor in school?
肯下功夫是学好功课的重要因素吗？
Think about every factor when you start a game.
开始游戏前要想到每个因素哦。
factual: The book about dinosaurs is factual and fun.
这本恐龙书既真实又有趣。
Is the story factual or just for fun?
这个故事是真的，还是编着玩的？
Be factual when you write about animals.
写动物的时候要写真事哦。
faculty: Her father is on the faculty at my school.
她爸爸是我们学校的教职员工。
Does the faculty eat in the lunchroom too?
老师们也在食堂吃饭吗？
Thank the faculty for a good school day!
谢谢老师们让我们度过了美好的一天！
fad: That little toy is a big fad at school.
那个小玩具在学校里特流行。
Was that toy just a short fad?
那个玩具只是一阵短暂的潮流吗？
What a fun fad those little toys were!
那些小玩具的风潮真好玩呀！
fairness: My father says fairness makes games fun.
爸爸说，公平才让游戏好玩。
Why do we need fairness in every game?
为什么每个游戏都需要公平呢？
Use fairness when you play with your friends.
和朋友玩的时候要讲公平哦。
falter: The old dog started to falter on the walk.
遛弯时，老狗的脚步开始不稳了。
Will your voice falter when you sing at school?
在学校唱歌时，你的声音会发抖吗？
Don't falter when the long walk gets hard.
长路难走的时候也不要退缩。
fame: The white horse found fame at the big circus.
那匹白马在大马戏团里出了名。
Would fame make you stop playing with your friends?
出了名你就不和朋友们玩了吗？
The little dog got so much fame!
那只小狗名气那么大呀！
famine: The story tells about a famine in old times.
这个故事讲的是古时候的一场饥荒。
In the famine, how did people find food?
闹饥荒的时候，人们怎么找吃的呢？
Let's give food to people in a famine.
我们给闹饥荒的人们捐些吃的吧。
famished: My dog is famished and wants its meal now.
我的狗饿坏了，现在就要吃饭。
Why are you so famished, little bear?
小熊，你怎么饿成这样呀？
Eat your lunch so you will not be famished.
把午饭吃完，就不会饿得慌了。
fancier: My grandfather is a bird fancier with ten birds.
我爷爷是个养鸟迷，养了十只鸟。
Does the cat fancier keep every little cat?
那位爱猫人把每只小猫都收养了吗？
Ask the bird fancier about his big parrot!
去问问养鸟人那只大鹦鹉的事吧！
fascinated: I am fascinated by the bugs in the garden.
花园里的小虫子把我深深迷住了。
Were you fascinated by the big lizards?
那些大蜥蜴把你迷住了吗？
The little girl was so fascinated by the spider!
小女孩被蜘蛛迷得不行！
fascinating: The book about dinosaurs is fascinating!
这本恐龙书太吸引人啦！
Why are spiders so fascinating to you?
蜘蛛为什么这么吸引你呀？
Come look at this fascinating bug!
快来看这只奇妙的小虫子！
fascination: His fascination with trains never stops.
他对火车的痴迷一点儿都没减。
What is your new fascination, little sister?
妹妹，你现在又迷上什么啦？
What a fascination snails are for little kids!
蜗牛对小朋友们来说真有魔力呀！
fashion: Long socks are the new fashion at school.
长筒袜是学校里流行的新穿法。
Why does your sister love fashion so much?
你姐姐为什么这么爱时髦呀？
Make a hat and start a new fashion!
做顶帽子，引领新潮流吧！
fatal: Too little water can be fatal for a goldfish.
水太少对金鱼来说可能是致命的。
Is a hot car fatal for a small dog?
闷热的车对小狗会致命吗？
Fast water can be fatal, so never swim there.
急流可能致命，千万别在那儿游泳。
fate: The story tells the fate of a little mouse.
这个故事讲了小老鼠的命运。
What fate will the little bunny have?
小兔子的命运会怎样呢？
What a good fate for the little bear!
fatigue: The long walk gave the old dog fatigue.
走完长路，老狗浑身疲劳。
Do your legs feel fatigue when you run far?
跑远了腿会觉得疲劳吗？
Take a nap when fatigue comes.
fault: It's not my fault the dog ate the cupcake!
狗把纸杯蛋糕吃了，可不是我的错！
Is it your fault that the tent is wet?
Look for the fault in the old robot.
找找老机器人出的毛病吧。
fauna: This book is about the fauna of the jungle.
这本书讲的是丛林里的动物。
What fauna lives in the cold ocean?
寒冷的海洋里住着哪些动物呢？
Draw the fauna you see near the pond.
把你在池塘边看到的动物画下来。
fearful: The little bunny was fearful of the big hawk.
小兔子很怕那只大老鹰。
Are you fearful of big dogs?
Don't be fearful of the little mouse!
fearsome: The dinosaur in the book looks fearsome.
书里的恐龙看起来很吓人。
Why does the fearsome bear sleep all winter?
那么吓人的熊为什么整个冬天都在睡觉呢？
Look at the fearsome lion in the tall grass!
快看高草里那头威风凛凛的狮子！
feat: The mouse did a big feat with that seed.
小老鼠运走那颗种子，可真是一大壮举。
Was the high jump a hard feat?
那次跳高是不是很了不起的难事？
Try this hard feat and stand on one leg!
来试试这个难动作，单腿站一站！
feature: A big slide is the new park feature.
大滑梯是这个公园的新设施。
What feature do you like in a good book?
一本好书，你喜欢它的哪些特点呢？
This car has a fun new feature!
这辆车有个好玩的新功能！
federal: Our city has a big federal building.
我们城里有一座很大的联邦大楼。
Who works in the federal building near the park?
公园旁边那座联邦大楼里是谁在工作？
Look at the tall federal building from the bus!
从公共汽车上看看那座高高的联邦大楼吧！
federation: Many teams play in the big baseball federation.
很多球队都参加大棒球联合会的比赛。
Does your sister swim for the city federation?
你姐姐是为市联合会游泳的吗？
Come watch the soccer federation games with us!
和我们一起去看足球联合会的比赛吧！
feedback: Her feedback helps me write good stories.
她的反馈帮我写出好故事。
What feedback did your father give you?
爸爸给了你什么反馈呀？
Please give me feedback on my story.
请给我的故事提提意见吧。
feint: He made a fast feint to the left.
他向左做了个快速的假动作。
Did you see his feint at the basketball game?
篮球赛上你看到他的假动作了吗？
Try a feint when you play soccer.
踢足球时可以试试假动作哦。
fellowship: The kids at camp have warm fellowship.
夏令营的孩子们情谊暖暖的。
Do you feel fellowship with your team?
你和队友之间有同伴情谊吗？
Sing together in fellowship at the camp fire.
围着营火，友爱地一起唱歌吧。
fermentation: Fermentation helps make bread and other foods.
发酵能帮我们做出面包和其他食物。
What does fermentation do to foods?
发酵能让食物怎么样呢？
Watch how fermentation makes the bread get big.
看看发酵怎么让面包鼓起来。
fertile: The fertile field gives us big orange carrots.
肥沃的田地里长出橙色的大胡萝卜。
Is the dirt in your garden fertile?
Put the seeds in the fertile dirt.
把种子种到肥沃的土里吧。
fertilization: Bees help with the fertilization of the flowers.
蜜蜂帮助花儿完成授粉。
What is fertilization in flowering plants?
开花植物的受粉是什么呢？
Read the page about fertilization in flowers.
读一读讲花儿受粉的那一页吧。
fertilize: Farmers fertilize the fields in the spring.
农民伯伯春天给田地上肥。
When does your father fertilize the big garden?
你爸爸什么时候给大花园施肥呀？
Fertilize the flowers to help them get big.
给花施施肥，帮它们长大。
fertilizer: Father put fertilizer on the little garden.
What does fertilizer do for the plants?
肥料对植物有什么用呢？
Buy some fertilizer for the little tomato plants!
给小番茄苗买点肥料吧！
festal: The stage looks festal with lights and balloons.
舞台上有灯又有气球，一派节日气氛。
What a festal day for our family!
对我们家来说，这是多喜庆的日子呀！
Sing festal songs together by the fire.
围着火一起唱节日的歌吧。
festive: The kids had festive hats and candy at school.
孩子们在学校戴上节日帽，还有糖果吃。
How festive the room looks with all those lights!
挂满彩灯的房间节日气氛真浓呀！
Let's make the classroom festive with balloons.
咱们用气球把教室装点出节日气氛吧！
festivity: The family meal was a time of festivity.
全家聚餐是一段欢庆时光。
What festivity do you like in winter?
冬天的欢庆活动里你喜欢什么呀？
Come to the festivity at school tomorrow!
明天来参加学校的庆祝活动哦。
feudal: In feudal times, farmers worked very hard.
在封建时代，农夫们干活非常辛苦。
Did farmers in feudal times have big houses?
封建时代的农夫住大房子吗？
Read about feudal times in this old book.
在这本旧书里读读封建时代的故事吧。
fiasco: Our picnic in the rain was a fiasco!
我们冒雨野餐，结果一团糟！
Why was the school play a fiasco?
学校的演出怎么搞砸了？
Watch the cupcake so it is not a fiasco!
看着点纸杯蛋糕，别把它烤砸了！
fiber: An apple has fiber that helps your body.
苹果里有纤维，对身体好。
Does fiber in vegetables keep you well?
蔬菜里的纤维能让你身体棒棒的吗？
Eat your vegetables to get fiber!
fiberglass: The boat is made of fiberglass.
Is your white helmet made of fiberglass?
你的白头盔是玻璃钢做的吗？
Look at that fiberglass slide in the park!
看公园里那个玻璃钢滑梯！
fidget: Try not to fidget at the table.
在饭桌上尽量别扭来扭去。
Why does the little dog fidget in the car?
小狗在车里为什么动来动去呀？
My brother will fidget when he sits too long.
我弟弟坐久了就会坐不住。
fidgety: The little dog gets fidgety in the car.
Are you fidgety when you sit too long?
坐太久你会不会扭来扭去呀？
Run outside if you feel fidgety.
觉得坐不住就出去跑一跑吧。
fielding: Fielding the ball well takes much work.
把球接好要下不少功夫。
Who did the fielding at today's baseball game?
今天棒球赛是谁负责接球防守的？
Work on your fielding every day.
每天都要练练接球防守哦。
fiend: The fiend in the story has big red eyes.
故事里的恶魔有一双大红眼睛。
Is the fiend in the book big or small?
书里的恶魔是大还是小呀？
Read about the fiend with the light on!
开着灯再读恶魔的故事哦！
fighter: My brother wants to be a fighter pilot.
我哥哥想当战斗机飞行员。
Who is the fighter on the red team?
红队的格斗选手是谁呀？
Be a good fighter in every game.
每场比赛都要做个好选手。
figure: Can you figure out how this toy works?
你能想明白这个玩具怎么玩吗？
I can't figure out the words in this book.
我看不懂这本书里的词。
Draw a stick figure on the paper.
在纸上画一个火柴小人吧。
filament: The spider hangs from a thin filament.
Can you see that thin filament by the window?
你能看到窗边那根细丝吗？
Look at the thin filament under the little spider!
看小蜘蛛下面的那根细丝！
file: Put the paper in the blue file, please.
请把纸放进蓝色文件夹里。
Which file has my drawing of the elephant?
我画的大象放在哪个文件夹里了？
I keep a file with all my stories.
我把写的故事都收在一个文件夹里。
filter: This filter keeps the water clean.
这个过滤器让水保持干净。
Does that filter clean the air in the car?
那个滤芯能净化车里的空气吗？
Put a new filter in the fish bowl.
finance: My father works in finance in a tall building.
我爸爸在一栋高楼里做金融工作。
Does your mother work in finance too?
你妈妈也做金融工作吗？
Ask him about his work in finance.
问问他金融工作的事情吧。
fingerprint: Your fingerprint has little lines on it.
你的指纹上有细细的纹路。
Does your fingerprint look like your mother's?
你的指纹和妈妈的像吗？
Put your fingerprint on the card, please.
请把你的指纹按在卡片上。
fir: The fir tree is green all winter.
冷杉树整个冬天都是绿的。
Is the big tree by the gate a fir?
大门旁那棵大树是冷杉吗？
Look at the little fir by the fence.
firestorm: A firestorm can start in the very dry grass.
特别干燥的草地上可能会燃起火焰风暴。
Did the rain stop the firestorm in the forest?
雨把森林里的火焰风暴浇灭了吗？
How fast the rain stopped the big firestorm!
雨那么快就浇灭了大火，真厉害！
firn: Firn is old snow that turns hard like ice.
粒雪是变成冰一样硬的老雪。
What is firn, and where do we find it?
粒雪是什么？我们在哪里能找到它？
Look at the firn in this book.
看这本书里的粒雪图片吧。
fissure: A little fissure in the rock has rain water.
岩石的小裂缝里积着雨水。
Can you see the fissure in the old wall?
你能看到老墙上的裂缝吗？
Watch your step near that little fissure.
在那道小裂缝附近走路要小心。
fizz: The drink will fizz when you open the bottle.
打开瓶子时，饮料会呲呲冒泡。
Can you hear the little fizz in your cup?
你能听到杯子里的呲呲声吗？
Watch the bubbles fizz up in the tub!
看浴缸里的泡泡呲呲地冒！
flabbergasted: I was flabbergasted when I saw the big cupcake.
看到那个大纸杯蛋糕，我惊呆了。
Were you flabbergasted by the big elephant?
那头大象有没有让你大吃一惊？
What a flabbergasted look she gave her father!
她看爸爸的那副惊呆样子呀！
flail: The dog will flail its legs in the air.
小狗会把腿在空中乱扑腾。
Why does the little bird flail in the bath?
小鸟洗澡时为什么扑腾个不停呀？
Don't flail your legs in the little boat.
flank: The cow has a black spot on its flank.
奶牛的身侧有个黑斑点。
Did you pat the horse on its flank?
Feel the warm flank of the sleeping dog!
摸摸睡着的小狗暖乎乎的身侧吧！
flatter: He tried to flatter his friend for a cookie.
他想哄一哄朋友，讨块饼干吃。
Does he flatter you just to get your candy?
他奉承你是不是就为了要你的糖？
Don't flatter me about my singing, please.
请不要夸大话夸我唱歌啦。
flattered: I was flattered when you liked my drawing.
你喜欢我的画，我心里美滋滋的。
Was your friend flattered by the nice card?
你的朋友收到好看的卡片很开心吗？
How flattered Grandmother was by your gift!
奶奶收到你的礼物，高兴坏了！
flattering: His flattering words made his mother smile.
他甜言蜜语，把妈妈逗笑了。
Why are your words so flattering today?
你今天说话怎么这么嘴甜呀？
What a flattering drawing of our family!
这张全家画像把我们画得真好看！
flattery: The fox used flattery to get the bird's food.
狐狸用奉承话骗到了小鸟的食物。
Is that flattery, or do you like my hat?
你是在奉承我，还是真的喜欢我的帽子？
Never use flattery to get your friend's candy.
千万别说好话骗朋友的糖吃。
flaunt: Good friends do not flaunt what they have.
好朋友不会炫耀自己的东西。
Why does he flaunt his new backpack every day?
他为什么天天炫耀新书包呀？
Don't flaunt your new bike to your friends.
别在朋友面前炫耀你的新自行车。
flax: The farmer plants flax in the big field.
Does flax have little blue flowers?
Feel the shirt made from flax!
摸摸这件亚麻做的衬衫吧！
flee: The bunnies flee from the fox into their hole.
小兔子们躲狐狸，逃进了洞里。
Where do little fish flee from big fish?
小鱼都往哪儿躲避大鱼呢？
Flee, little mouse, the owl is here!
快逃呀小老鼠，猫头鹰来啦！
fleet: A fleet of little boats sits on the lake.
一小队小船停泊在湖上。
Did you see the fleet of big trucks?
你看到那支大卡车车队了吗？
Draw a big fleet of boats on the paper.
flexible: The girl on the stage is very flexible.
台上的女孩身体真柔软。
Is this hose flexible when it is cold?
天冷的时候这根水管还软和吗？
Use your body every day to keep it flexible.
天天锻炼，身体才柔软灵活。
floodplain: The river runs over its floodplain in spring.
What animals live on the floodplain?
河滩上住着哪些动物呢？
Look at the wide floodplain from the train!
从火车上看看宽阔的河滩吧！
fluctuate: Bird numbers here fluctuate from day to day.
这里鸟的数量天天变来变去。
Does the water in the pond fluctuate much?
池塘里的水位变化大吗？
Watch the numbers fluctuate on the screen.
看屏幕上的数字上下变动吧。
fluke: Getting two gifts in one day was a fluke.
一天收到两份礼物纯属巧合。
Is it a fluke, or are you that good?
这是碰巧，还是你真的很厉害？
That try was just a fluke, so try again!
刚才那下只是碰巧，再来一次吧！
flurry: I saw a flurry of snow from my window.
我从窗户看到了一阵小雪。
Did you see the little flurry of snow yesterday?
昨天那阵小雪你看到了吗？
What a big flurry of snow outside!
外面下起好大一阵雪呀！
flustered: The big noise made the new kid flustered.
巨大的响声把新来的小孩弄得慌慌张张。
Why do you get flustered when you sing?
你唱歌时怎么会慌张呀？
Don't get flustered, and just try again.
fob: A red fob hangs from his old watch.
他的旧表上挂着一条红色小表坠。
What does the little fob do?
那个小表坠是干什么用的呀？
Look at the fob swinging from his watch!
看他表上晃来晃去的小表坠！
foist: Don't foist your work on your little brother.
别把自己的活儿硬塞给弟弟。
Did she foist her old toys on you?
她把自己的旧玩具硬塞给你了吗？
He always foists the hard work on other kids.
他总是把苦活推给别的孩子。
foliage: The green foliage on the trees looks cool.
树上的绿叶看起来真清凉。
What little animals live in the foliage?
树叶丛里住着哪些小动物呢？
Look at the colorful foliage in the park!
看公园里五彩缤纷的树叶呀！
footage: We watched footage of whales swimming in the ocean.
我们看了鲸鱼在大海里游泳的影像片段。
Did the camera get footage of the fox?
摄像机拍到狐狸的画面了吗？
Come watch the old footage of the beach!
